indicators.context: Out-of-band collector of the OpenHack v0.x pentest agent (PyPI openhack 0.2.4): oob_register returns https://oob.openhack.com/<label>-<12 hex> for blind SSRF, command injection and XXE payloads (OOB_URL overrides it). A target that resolves or calls it ran the agent's payload; the agent's own host polls /_hits on it
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the OpenHack source code

indicators.context: Default model gateway (https://api.openhack.com/v1, bearer OPENHACK_API_KEY) and update check (/updates?current=<version>) of the OpenHack v0.x agent. A host that contacts it runs OpenHack 0.x; the vendor's own service
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the OpenHack source code

indicators.context: Sign-up and device-login site of the OpenHack v0.x agent (PROD_APP_URL). Vendor site; context only
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the OpenHack source code

indicators.context: OpenHack v2 installer (curl -fsSL https://install.openhack.com | sh), a Cloudflare Worker that serves install.sh, which downloads the release from GitHub into ~/.local/bin/openhack
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the OpenHack source code

indicators.context: Release path the OpenHack v2 installer downloads from: v<version>/openhack-<version>-<darwin|linux>-<arm64|x64>.tar.gz and .sha256
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the OpenHack source code

indicators.context: Exact user agent the OpenHack v0.x agent sends on its model list call to api.openhack.com/v1/models, collector polls to oob.openhack.com, ChatGPT token calls to auth.openai.com and the models.dev catalog fetch. Short, so match it exactly, not as a substring
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the OpenHack source code

indicators.context: User agent of the OpenHack v0.x web_fetch and keyless search tools (httpx). Real Chrome writes Chrome/125.0.0.0; the two-part version is the tell. web_fetch fetches any URL the model gives it, including target pages
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the OpenHack source code

indicators.context: Canary marker the OpenHack v0.x hunter and validator prompts use to prove write access: rows __openhack_test_probe and __openhack_test_probe_updated, email __openhack_test_@example.com, inserted, read back with ?name=eq.__openhack_test_probe, updated and deleted (openhack/prompts/hunter.py:176-189, openhack/prompts/val
